unauthenticated_routes.GET /healthz: liveness probe; an authenticated probe cannot report health before auth works
unauthenticated_routes.GET /readyz: readiness probe; same reason, and it must answer during a dependency outage
unauthenticated_routes.GET /v1/auth/branding/:tenant: published display-only branding must render before login; no identity or data access
unauthenticated_routes.GET /v1/auth/login/request/:id: renders the login form before any Helivanta session exists
unauthenticated_routes.POST /v1/auth/login: creates the Helivanta session and therefore cannot require one
unauthenticated_routes.POST /v1/auth/login/enroll: confirms the newly enrolled second factor that creates the session, so it cannot require one
unauthenticated_routes.POST /v1/auth/login/factor: checks the second factor that creates the session, so it cannot require one
unauthenticated_routes.POST /v1/auth/login/password: checks the credential that creates the session, so it cannot require one
unauthenticated_routes.POST /v1/auth/login/password-change: completes a sign-in whose password must change first, so it cannot require a session
